WHY WE WALK

Faith is received.
In the Church, it is shared.

Almería, puerto de fe has a Catholic vocation: to place apostolic memory at the service of evangelisation and of the communities that live and pass on the faith today. We seek to walk with parishes, listen to the diocesan Church and welcome those who seek God.

01 /

Prayer

Listen to the Word, encounter Christ and recognise the central place of the Eucharist in Christian life.

02 /

Communion

Walk with the Church: families, priests, consecrated people, confraternities and parish communities.

03 /

Mission

Pass on the faith through hospitality, service and care for those most in need.

THE CATHOLIC COMMUNITY AT THE HEART

A living Church.
A community in mission.

Apostolic memory finds meaning when it bears fruit today: a welcoming parish, a family passing on the faith, a young person discovering a vocation or a community accompanying someone who is alone.

I

The Eucharist at the centre

Propose times of prayer, listening to the Gospel and participation in parish sacramental life, with pastoral guidance.

II

A faith learned and shared

Prepare gatherings for families, catechists and young people around Saint Indaletius, apostolic witness and the mission of the Church.

III

Charity as a witness

Connect the journey with an act of service agreed with the host community: accompany, listen and respond to concrete needs.

Proposed pastoral priorities to develop with parishes and present to the diocese.

01 — THE ORIGINS

An apostolic memory.
A calling for today.

Receive the Gospel.
Live it. Proclaim it.

Tradition tells of Torquatus, Ctesiphon, Indaletius, Secundus, Euphrasius, Caecilius and Hesychius, sent from Rome to proclaim the Gospel in Hispania.

The tradition of the Seven Apostolic Men recalls an enduring vocation: to proclaim Jesus Christ. Understanding its sources and context helps us share this memory with spiritual faithfulness and historical rigour.

Explore the sources ↗

AGUADULCE · TURANIANA

Every great journey
begins with a first step.

We imagine that first step beside the sea at Aguadulce. The nearby archaeological site of Ribera de la Algaida, or Turaniana, is protected as a Site of Cultural Interest and opens a window onto this coastline’s past.

Archaeology provides context; the arrival of the seven missionaries at this particular place remains a question for research. From this shore, we propose a journey of heritage, hospitality and prayer.

THE SEVEN APOSTOLIC MEN

Seven witnesses.
A Church on the way.

Tradition remembers seven evangelisers united by one mission: proclaiming the Gospel. Their memory invites our communities to renew their apostolic vocation today.

01

Torquatus

Acci · Guadix

02

Ctesiphon

Vergi · Berja

03

Indaletius

Urci · Pechina area

ALMERÍA
04

Secundus

Abula · associated with Abla

05

Euphrasius

Iliturgi · Andújar tradition

06

Caecilius

Iliberri · Elvira / Granada

07

Hesychius

Carcere · location debated

Traditional identifications; some connections between ancient sees and present-day towns remain disputed.

03 — WITH THE CHURCH OF ALMERÍA

Saint Indaletius.
A faith passed on.

According to tradition, the Church of Almería honours Saint Indaletius as its founder. Pechina keeps this devotion alive, with 15 May as its principal reference date.

The Catholic community is at the heart of this proposal: parish life, the witness of families, the vocation of young people and the service of priests and consecrated people. Its pastoral development is offered for the discernment of the diocesan Church.

BE STILL. YOU ARE ON THE WAY.

May every step
become an encounter.

For our diocese, its pastors and every community that proclaims the Gospel.

The Almería, puerto de fe prayer+

Lord Jesus Christ,
you sent your apostles
to proclaim the Gospel to all peoples.

Renew the faith of our Church of Almería.
Sustain our bishop, our priests,
consecrated men and women, and all our families.

May your Word light our way,
the Eucharist nourish our communion,
and your love become service to those most in need.

Through the intercession of Saint Indaletius,
make us a welcoming community,
a Church that listens and a people that evangelises.

Amen.

An original prayer proposed for this initiative.

04 — A PROPOSAL AT THE SERVICE OF THE CHURCH

Rooted in faith.
Open to mission.

An independent Catholic initiative seeking to serve the Church. The next step is to present the proposal to the diocese, listen to parishes and consider its pastoral purpose together.

01 / DISCERN

Listen to the Church

Present the proposal to the bishop’s office and review its historical and pastoral foundations. Listen to priests, parish communities and specialists.

02 / PREPARE

Walk in communion

Develop catechetical materials, an accessible pilgrimage experience and hospitality coordinated with participating parishes.

03 / SERVE

Bear fruit in the community

Propose a pilot day of prayer, formation and service. Assess whether it nurtures faith, strengthens relationships and responds to real needs.

FAITH AND RIGOUR, ON THE SAME PATH

A tradition to receive.
A history to explore.

We respect the account’s spiritual value and distinguish documented evidence from questions that require research. The initiative has no diocesan approval and is not an officially recognised pilgrimage route.
